text: 【A股沪指失守3900点】24日，A股低开低走，沪指盘中跌破3900点，跌0.93%。深成指、创业板指均跌超1.6%。全市超4200只个股下跌。板块方面，贵金属大跌，房地产、医药、电子元器件、生物科技、石化、通信设备、半导体等跌幅居前。银行、教育等上涨。
text_en: [A-share Shanghai Composite Index falls below 3900 points] On the 24th, A-shares opened lower and moved lower, with the Shanghai Composite Index falling below 3900 points during the session, down 0.93%. The Shenzhen Component Index and ChiNext Index both fell more than 1.6%. More than 4,200 stocks across the market declined. By sector, precious metals fell sharply, while real estate, pharmaceuticals, electronic components, biotechnology, petrochemicals, communication equipment, and semiconductors led the declines. Banks and education rose.
